definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.["activity:read"]: "Read the user's activity data for activities that are visible to Everyone and Followers, excluding privacy zone data"
definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.["activity:read_all"]: "The same access as activity:read, plus privacy zone data and access to read the user's activities with visibility set to Only You"

definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.["activity:write"]: "Access to create manual activities and uploads, and access to edit any activities that are visible to the app, based on activity read access level"
definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.["profile:read_all"]: "Read all profile information even if the user has set their profile visibility to Followers or Only You"
definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.["profile:write"]: "Update the user's weight and Functional Threshold Power (FTP), and access to star or unstar segments on their behalf"
definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.read: "Read public segments, public routes, public profile data, public posts, public events, club feeds, and leaderboards"
definitions.strava_oauth.scopes.read_all: "Read private routes, private segments, and private events for the user"
